summary: Added the bounded private GitHub Actions gate and a read-only verifier that binds CI to the exact repository source digest and existing M6.5 evidence. Local workflow-structure checks, Ruff and the complete 86-test suite pass; no M7 execution surface or research budget changed.

commands.summary: CI evidence verifier passes repository Ruff rules.

commands.command: .venv/bin/python -m ruff check src tests scripts --exclude scripts/vendor
commands.summary: All self-authored source, tests and scripts pass Ruff.

commands.command: .venv/bin/python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; d=yaml.load(Path('.github/workflows/m65-external-quality-gate.yml').read_text(), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader); assert 'pull_request' in d['on']; assert 'm6-5-external-quality-gate' in d['jobs']"
commands.summary: Workflow structure and external gate job are present.
